## What is the process for exporting USD* from Blender, handling assets from the web or generated by AI, and exporting them for use in the engine?
### Export USDC/Z (general)

1. Select the content to export. If exporting multiple objects, simply use **Select > All**.
   | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/9f43f2cdb7bb4296a2b10ae30dc9b9f6~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/c4388786fba4459a850c20b8eaa06783~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
   | --- | --- |
2. Select the export file format. The USDZ archive type is more suitable for assets whose effects have already been finalized, and pay attention to ensuring that the output options are consistent with those in Figure 3.
   | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/3346d27d39f6435980240576257c12f9~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) <br> Figure 1 | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/53fdb5f6b2074e4b811ce0656e01977d~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) <br> Figure 2 | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/8a4483a82da548578b09c9c7543715ce~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) <br> Figure 3 |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   Actual effects:
   | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/5a3a9e8c422448c9b5ed1fd5acfe2799~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/55fff2be9641448fad39540a4cbe89c5~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
   | --- | --- |

### Obtain network resources and process them with Blender

1. Acquire an asset.
   For example: https://polyhaven.com/models
   1. Select assets and download related assets
      * For example, https://polyhaven.com/a/marble_bust_01 was selected.
      * View the model description on the page. If it exceeds 60k, it is recommended to switch to another model. By the way, confirm the height, as it will be the default representation of your asset in the project. Adjust the texture resolution to suit your needs; 1k is generally sufficient, while 2k provides greater detail. Change the download format to USD, and click Download.
         <div style="text-align: center"><img src="https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/66a1a5ce25be443bae8d5fd5fb3b299d~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image" width="800px" />         </div>

   2. Click **Download** to download and extract.
   3. Download asset textures directly. On the website, click to open a texture and save it manually.
      | Click the area marked by the red box <br> ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/0e7b42cccf42461792b99a10e259c2a7~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) | Download the diffuse, normal, and rough PNG maps separately. <br> ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/05104f6186ac423bb02fc9ec35e35cae~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
      | --- | --- |
2. Processing in Blender.
   1. Import assets
      1. Open Blender and clear the default scene.
         | 1. select menu - select all <br>  <br>  | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/e118cb785dae47a0a9718e4c25c12c75~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
         | --- | --- |
         | 2. Right-click / On Mac, two-finger tap on the touchpad - Delete | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/c47e922630bf49bdb7200685c70f8fa0~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
         | 3. (Optional) File - clean - purge <br>  <br>  | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/9717931328ad4c9988b5444f4b0003b1~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
      2. Import USD assets.
         | 1. Drag the extracted USDC into the designated location. <br>  <br>  | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/5832374ac5bf455086395eafa51992ee~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
         | --- | --- |
         | 2. Leave all settings at their default values, then click Import. <br>  <br>  | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/798987372d204499a33ac164ec924953~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
         | 3. Click the icon in the red box to preview the material. Scroll the mouse wheel to zoom in or out. Hold down the middle mouse button and drag to change the view angle. Hold down Shift and the middle mouse button, then drag to move the viewing position. <br>  <br>  | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/612fdc74b9374192bb8c8c4a2b6b97c0~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
      3. When setting materials, it is recommended to perform a complete reset to avoid image storage errors.
         1. Select **Shader Editor**  to enter material editing.
            ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/3bf583f58a124b15923e28b846c5d291~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)
         2. Observe the content of the brown section.
            Here you can see that one is missing. If you are not familiar, you can delete all the brown columns.
            ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/7c86f0395e0e4fc9a5ed7aefdd904f6a~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)
         3. Select the brown column, right-click, and select **Delete**.
            ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/6ab902a60ff24ae5a885bec1e36e5c20~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)
         4. Clean up files.
            ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/2d0cabf992a04aaeb9022b0f3e2c2311~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)
         5. Reassign the downloaded material (set the basic PBR).
            1. Open the previously downloaded materials and find the files containing `_diff` or `Diffuse` in their names. Drag into the material editor and connect to BaseColor.
               | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/b102ed74dac5435ba9459b481bf6e9bb~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/abe7ce867ff449659ed60d2c5b70bf61~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
               | --- | --- |
            2. Find files containing `_norm,_n,_` or `normal`. Drag it into the material editor, change the color space of this node to Non-Color, and finally connect it to the Color input of the purple Normal Map node.
               | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/19060afdccc54f62a8d275584f24517d~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/e9ca39206e2c41c4a30213a64f20fad2~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/dbd85a6ab41f4b4a9db00b5373863ba3~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
               | --- | --- | --- |
            3. Find files containing `_rough,_r,_` or `roughness`. Drag it into the material editor, set the color space of this node to non-color, and finally connect it to roughness.
               | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/5315abf0032540b69a38cb235ee0bf42~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/f9827e4be93e422299d87f31ce93234a~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/c550b34eaf9e43819f471cbabf256c11~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
               | --- | --- | --- |
         6. Switch back to layout mode and observe the result.
            | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/9e1c1e2c5aa749ff8aeff27cb4b6b348~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) | ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/e051baa1a7194f009d6b24bd114cdfaf~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
            | --- | --- |
      4. Export files.
         Please specifically refer to the section above titled "Export USDC/Z (general)".
